title: How to Advertise Your Local Business on Facebook

facts.fact: Facebook's 'store traffic' campaign objective was previously labelled 'local awareness'.
facts.quote: Previously labelled “local awareness,” the “store traffic” campaign objective in Facebook Ads Manager can attract ideal customers to your business

facts.fact: By default, the store traffic campaign objective serves ads on a 'daily unique reach' basis, meaning Facebook delivers ads to each individual in the target audience once per day.
facts.quote: the store traffic campaign objective serves ads by default on a “daily unique reach” basis. What this means is that Facebook will deliver your ads to individuals within your specified audience once per day.

facts.fact: According to Facebook, only a small number of advertisers had been selected to optimize store traffic campaigns for 'store visits'.
facts.quote: Some businesses have the ability to optimize the delivery of their campaigns for “store visits” but according to Facebook, only a small number of advertisers currently have been selected to have this capability.

facts.fact: Some Facebook placements were temporarily unavailable for store traffic objective ads due to COVID-19, when those ads only appeared in the Facebook News Feed.
facts.quote: some placements were temporarily unavailable for store traffic objective ads due to COVID-19—they were only appearing in the Facebook News Feed.

facts.fact: The article recommends setting budget optimization at the campaign level for simplicity, where the advertiser tells Facebook how much to spend per day.
facts.quote: For simplicity’s sake I suggest setting the budget optimization at the campaign level. By choosing this, you simply tell Facebook how much you want to spend on your ads per day.

facts.fact: WordStream recommends creating 3-4 ad variations and no more than 5 for a given Ad Set in Facebook local ads.
facts.quote: Ideally you’ll want to create 3-4 ad variations and no more than 5 for a given Ad Set.

facts.fact: For store traffic ads, Facebook offers the "call now", "get directions", and "send message" calls to action within a single campaign, which WordStream describes as unique to the store traffic objective.
facts.quote: Having the ability to create “call now”, “get directions”, and “send message” calls to action within a single campaign is rather unique to the store traffic objective.

facts.fact: Frequency measures how many times an ad has been served to an individual user over a period, and WordStream suggests refreshing creative when frequency is high while link clicks are decreasing over the same period.
facts.quote: If you are experiencing a high level of frequency after having run your ads for days or weeks in addition to witnessing link clicks decreasing over that same period, it may be time to refresh your ad creative

facts.fact: WordStream advises that if a local store traffic campaign struggles to reach its daily spend limit, the audience may be too small or the spend limit too high.
facts.quote: If the campaign is understanding or struggling to reach the daily limit then it may be an indication that the audience is too small or the spend limit is too high.

facts.fact: In Facebook's carousel ad format for store traffic, advertisers can include a map card showing their business location.
facts.quote: What’s great about the carousel option for store traffic is that you have the option to include a map card showing your businesses location
